description: PHP source code for Smarty Internal Plugin Resource String class, implementing string resources for Smarty templates, including methods for populating source metadata, decoding resource strings, and building unique resource names.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Resource_String
classes.description: Implements string-based template resources for Smarty, providing methods for resource handling, decoding, and metadata management.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the source object with metadata based on the resource.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Loads the template's source content by decoding the resource string.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes base64 or URL-encoded strings based on prefix.

methods.name: buildUniqueResourceName
methods.description: Creates a unique resource name based on class and decoded resource string.

methods.name: getBasename
methods.description: Returns an empty string as the basename for the resource.

methods.name: checkTimestamps
methods.description: Disables timestamp checks for string resources, always returning false.
